feature: ClamAV private signature generations and owner CLI, phase one

implementation.platforms: non-root POSIX macOS/Linux; Windows update backend disabled
validation: required signed CVDs and sigtool verification
implementation.publication: private candidate, fsync, atomic current reference replacement and read-back
implementation.concurrency: cross-process updater/publication locks and shared generation leases; running scan retains its generation
implementation.checkpoint_context: private definition content digest, engine identity, semantic settings and target fingerprints
implementation.external_explicit_database_change: normal scan pre/post manifest checks; partial, unresolved coverage and nonreusable evidence
implementation.failed_attempt_policy: retain private pending/staging state; block another download until owner recovery; never clear provider cooldown automatically

review_fixes.found_with: Synthetic databases, a mocked engine and threads on scratch copies of c7945a0 and 008d57f; no personal folders, real updates or downloads

fixed.issue: An unchanged custom database file in an explicit database folder made every ordinary scan partial and batch evidence never reusable
fixed.reproduced: c7945a0: completed and resume reused 3 targets; 008d57f: partial and resume rescanned all 3 every time
fixed.fix: Change detection identifies every database entry (custom ones included, updater bookkeeping excluded); the grouping manifest stays official-only

fixed.issue: Two scans or checks starting together failed immediately
fixed.reproduced: The second of two simultaneous checks returned 'Operation could not complete'
fixed.fix: The publication lock covers only the reference read, lease and switch, with the normal short wait; hashing and fsync run outside it; the shared private-store thread lock waits within the store deadline

fixed.issue: Cancellation or timeout during an uncertain reference replacement reported cancelled and published=false
fixed.reproduced: Ctrl-C during the durability step reported cancelled/published false while the reference already named the new generation
fixed.fix: An unknown publication stays unknown with published=null

fixed.issue: An unreadable reference after a scan was reported as newer definitions
fixed.fix: newer_generation_available is null with a separate could-not-confirm warning
